title: Chapter 336 Visiting Here
content:
Chapter 336 Visiting Here

He is indeed a great figure who even Master Venerable attaches so much importance to.

Time and Space Win thought so in my heart.

"Follow me to go around the long river of time and space."

Seeing the victory of time and space, Lu Daosheng said lightly.

Hearing this, although Shikong Ying was puzzled and did not know what the adult in front of him had done to the long river of Shikong and Space, he still nodded.

As long as Lu Daosheng is not too much, he will basically not refuse Lu Daosheng.

Of course, even if Lu Daosheng was really too much, he had no other way except to swallow his anger.

Because he could not feel Lu Daosheng's aura, there was only one possibility, that is, Lu Daosheng's strength was far above him.

Buzz —

As Time and Space Win gently stroked the space in front of you, ripples suddenly appeared in the space.

Immediately afterwards, a time and space tunnel appeared in front of time and space.

"Sir, please."

Time and Space Win stood aside and lowered his head slightly.

Lu Daosheng nodded lightly and stepped in directly.

As the light flashed in front of me, the surrounding space suddenly began to flow rapidly.

After a moment.

A long river of time and space that connects ancient and modern times appeared in front of Lu Daosheng.

It still looks like he had seen, but the one in front of him was unprecedentedly huge.

"Sir, this is the real long river of time and space."

At this time, Shikongying appeared behind Lu Daosheng, with a little bit of pride in his tone.

Over the years, he has been managing it himself.

At this time, Lu Daosheng looked at the long river of time and space in front of him, but his expression gradually became solemn.

After a moment of silence, Lu Daosheng slowly walked to the bank of the long river of time and space. The long river of time and space in front of him was extremely turbulent, and he could not see at first sight.

Seeing Lu Daosheng approaching the long river of time and space, Shi Space Ying's eyes were immediately a little worried.

"Sir, it's better to be careful not to get involved, as the consequences are unimaginable."

Even he just dared to watch from a distance.

He has never been the master of the long river of time and space, he is just responsible for protecting it.

Hearing the reminder of Shishi Ying, Lu Daosheng didn't care at all. The next moment, under the horrified gaze of Shishi Ying, Lu Daosheng reached into the long Hanoi of Shishi and Space.

"What!"

Behind him, the exclamation of time and space win suddenly rang out.

His eyes widened at this moment, his eyes full of disbelief.

The long river of time and space did not harm Lu Daosheng at all.

"Can the long river of time and space have become docile now?"

Time and Space Winning said to himself in his heart.

Seeing Lu Daosheng's eyes closed slightly, as if he was feeling something, Shishi and Space Ying suddenly felt unbearable.

"Since the long river of time and space is no longer dangerous, then as the master of the palace of the time and space, I can also personally experience the mystery of the long river of time and space. Isn't it too much?"

Time and Space Ying murmured to himself, and then walked straight to the bank of the long river of time and space, and directly reached into the long river of time and space by learning Lu Daosheng's appearance.

In an instant, a terrifying force of time and space spread out from the long river, and the arm of time and space win instantly wrapped the whole body of time and space win.

The next moment, Shikong Ying's face changed drastically, and he felt that his whole body had lost his strength. Then, a terrifying pulling force dragged him into the long river of time and space, and with the impact of the long river of time and space, he went down the flow.

"Sir, save me!!"

The cry for winning time and space sounded from time and space in the long Hanoi.

At this moment, he was afraid and anxious because he deeply felt that his life span was rapidly passing.

In no time, he will completely die in the long river of time and space.

And it is also a way to die if you run out of life.

The dignified Lord of the Palace of Time and Space and the guardian of the long river of time and space, is going to die tragically within the long river of time and space.

At this time, Lu Daosheng looked up slightly and noticed the winning of time and space, calling for help from him.

At this moment, Shishi and Space Win is still shouting desperately at him.

Lu Daosheng didn't say anything, but directly reached out to win in time and space.

Suddenly, an ultimate force was to pull the space-time win out of the long river of time and space.

"Cough, cough, cough, vomit!"

Sitting on the shore in a mess, Shikongying couldn't stop trembling.

Just now, the fear of dying was very, very deep.

That was despair he had never felt before.

What's even more terrifying is that after this incident, his life span was severely damaged. He was still as elegant as a man at the beginning, but now his hair was half white.

Step into the gates of hell with one foot.

"So much, thank you for helping me!"

After a long time, Shikongying recovered and knelt down directly towards Lu Daosheng.

It is a blessing in disgrace to be able to survive from time and space.

Now that he thought of this, he realized how terrifying Lu Daosheng was.

It turns out that it is not that the long river of time and space is not dangerous, but that Lu Daosheng is too strong.

If the long river of time and space is strong, it will not infect him at all.

If he could figure it out at that time, he would not have fallen to this point. In the final analysis, he was too greedy.

Faced with the mystery of the long river of time and space, he obviously did not control himself.

"Let's go."

Lu Daosheng took a last look at the long river of time and space beside him and then said softly.

"Yes, sir."

The two of them quickly left here and returned to the front of the Time and Space Hall.

At this time, Lu Daosheng's goal had been achieved.

After looking at the somewhat embarrassed time and space win, Lu Daosheng said lightly: "If you want to make up for your life, go to my wasteland city, where there is what you want."

Leaving this sentence, Lu Daosheng's body trembled and disappeared directly from the spot.

"Wild City."

Time and Space Ying looked at the direction where Lu Daosheng disappeared and murmured to himself.

At this time, a phantom appeared beside Time and Space Ying.

"Sir, you!"

Seeing the appearance of Shishi and Space Win, the phantom looked shocked.

And Shishi and Space Win said in a deep voice: "Everything in the hall is as usual. You, follow me to the other side of the starry sky."

"On the other side of the starry sky? Sir, what are you doing in that kind of place?"

Taking a deep breath, Shikongying glared at the phantom beside him.

Suddenly, the phantom trembled all over and nodded quickly: "Yes, sir, I will prepare now."

After a moment, two streams of light flew straight out of the Time and Space Hall.

......

On the other side, Lu Daosheng came to a place with extremely strong Yin energy.

A huge door hole appeared in front of me.

Hall of Reincarnation!

This time, no one came out to take over Lu Daosheng's arrival.

However, this had no effect on Lu Daosheng.

After looking at it for a moment, Lu Daosheng walked in on his own.

Along the way, the yin energy was filled with it, as if he had really arrived at the underworld, which made Lu Daosheng feel a little happy.

Could it be that we can see the cow head and horse face next?

After a while, Lu Daosheng suddenly stopped walking.

"Can eternal life be seen in the cycle of reincarnation by chanting my true name?"

A dark red stone pillar was engraved with such a domineering words.

So crazy?

After a moment of silence, Lu Daosheng poked out his index finger and slashed at the stone pillar in front of him.

Immediately, Lu Daosheng raised his foot and left here.

The original font on the stone pillar has disappeared, and replaced by a strange word - Lu Daosheng has visited here.
